prompts.capsule: Use case: illustration-story. Production game UI asset. A single premium toy capsule sphere, front view, centered and isolated on genuinely transparent background. Perfectly round sphere. Upper hemisphere translucent dusty pink with soft hand-painted curved reflections, lower hemisphere ivory and muted sage pearlescent enamel. Fine honey-gold equatorial rim lies EXACTLY at vertical 50% of image. Small embossed golden paw seal at center seam, tiny star and leaf embellishments. Cozy watercolor gouache storybook fantasy game, clean delicate warm brown outlines, tactile shading, tasteful polished detail readable at 100 pixels. Square composition with sphere occupying 80% of width and height, no floating particles, no floor, no background, no letters, no watermark. Not photorealistic, not flat vector.
prompts.book: Use case: illustration-story. Production game UI asset, closed photo album front cover, perfectly straight-on orthographic front view, portrait proportions 3:4. An exquisite forest storybook bound in deep sage green linen with a stitched cream leather spine, fine embossed honey-gold botanical border, small corner protectors and a dusty rose silk bookmark. Central oval cameo medallion shows a cute cream and tan long-haired Chihuahua with a broad white forehead blaze, rounded apple head, large upright ears, big brown eyes and pinkish brown nose. Soft watercolor gouache, elegant hand-painted warm outlines, tactile paper/linen texture, cozy pastel fantasy game style. Leave a small blank cream ribbon below cameo for code-rendered title. Fully isolated transparent background; cover only, no floor, no shadow extending beyond asset, no letters or watermark. Refined and charming, not photorealistic.
prompts.costume: Use case: illustration-story. Production game sprite atlas on genuinely transparent background. EXACT GRID 4 columns by 5 rows, 20 separate equally spaced cells; no margins labels or grid lines. Each cell same full-body little long-haired cream and tan Chihuahua hero, broad white blaze down forehead, large upright ears, short round muzzle, pink-brown nose, big dark brown eyes, fluffy white tail, small compact body and short legs. Costume: Dreamstar Guardian Nemo, ivory and pastel lavender short celestial cape, pearl blue tunic, small gold star clasp, tiny translucent aurora winglets on back, a delicate crescent moon circlet nestled between ears. Row1 FRONT facing down toward viewer; Row2 FRONT THREE QUARTER facing lower right; Row3 SIDE facing right; Row4 BACK THREE QUARTER facing upper right; Row5 BACK facing up away from viewer. Each creature fully fits its cell with 15% blank gutter, all feet aligned to same baseline within cell, all poses same scale. Refined cute hand-painted mobile fantasy game, clean warm brown outlines, soft watercolor gouache shading, simple clear shapes readable as 80px game character. Match a charming cream/tan Chihuahua not a fox or corgi. No background, letters, labels, watermark or extra objects.
